mapper.select: SELECT DATE(statistics_order.created_at) AS date, COUNT(*) AS total_order_count, SUM( CASE WHEN statistics_order.status = 'PICKED_UP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS completed_order_count, SUM( CASE WHEN statistics_order.status IN ('CANCELED', 'REJECTED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS canceled_order_count FROM orders AS statistics_order WHERE statistics_order.created_at >= #{start} AND statistics_order.created_at < #{end} GROUP BY DATE(statistics_order.created_at) ORDER BY DATE(statistics_order.created_at)

SELECT DATE(statistics_payment.approved_at) AS date, SUM(statistics_payment.amount) AS sales_amount FROM payments AS statistics_payment WHERE statistics_payment.status = 'DONE' AND statistics_payment.approved_at >= #{start} AND statistics_payment.approved_at < #{end} GROUP BY DATE(statistics_payment.approved_at) ORDER BY DATE(statistics_payment.approved_at)
